probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, read 2026-10-15): PERFECT COVERAGE RATE — the share of plays on which the coverage unit makes NO mistake, charted with the QB EPA on those plays. It is the coverage half of the disruption definition (C-309): a defense disrupts either by rush timing or by covering a play perfectly, and this rate counts the second path. Role in-engine: the standing form of the question tonight's SEA@DEN read asked about Denver — with the starting secondary out, does the coverage unit still play mistake-free football, or does the perfect-coverage rate crack before the counting stats show it?
